result.summary: The page is largely intact; the only notable defect is a suspicious discount badge reading "-100%" on the lower card. Horizontal carousel clipping and the card cut off at the bottom edge are treated as intentional scroll behavior, not defects.

issues.description: The discount badge on the partially shown lower card reads "-100%", a negative value that is ambiguous and likely incorrect for a promotion (it reads as a negative discount rather than "100% off" or "Free").
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data and display it as a positive offer label such as "100% off" or "Free" instead of "-100%".
